papers.title: Price of Anarchy of First-Price Auctions in Agentic Markets
papers.titleZh: 代理市场中第一价格拍卖的价格无效率性
papers.abstract: An agentic market is a decentralized serving-time market where AI agents bid to claim each user prompt. An agent's bid is based on its expected value for the prompt, which is the expectation of the reward for its response minus its inference costs. First-price auctions (FPAs), in which the highest bidder pays its bid and receives the prompt, are a natural way to allocate prompts in such a market, since they are simple and transparent to run, and do not require central knowledge of private capabilities and costs. However, FPAs are not truthful: participants may bid less than their true value in the hope of a larger profit, and the prompt may then be allocated to someone other than the bidder who values it the most. This welfare loss is quantified by the $\textit{price-of-anarchy}$ (PoA). In this paper, we argue that agentic markets are likely to possess features that reduce the price-of-anarchy. The first is a $\textit{competitive floor}$, which occurs when multiple bidders usually value the prompt above some baseline share of the optimal welfare (e.g., because the best models are often distilled into cheaper alternatives, which perform similarly). We show that competition among them then limits the welfare loss, which can be driven to zero as the floor rises. The second feature is $\textit{near-independence}$ of values after conditioning on the prompt, which occurs when most of the predictable variation in the expected value is determined by the difficulty of the prompt. As the value distribution approaches conditional independence, we can derive an efficiency guarantee that approaches a factor of $1 - 1/e^2$ of the optimal welfare. Thus, both features give rise to welfare lower bounds that are significantly better than the well-known general case of $1 - 1/e$. We validate these results empirically using auctions with strategic bidders simulated on the EmbedLLM prompt routing dataset.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 为什么在AI代理竞争服务用户的市场中，简单的一价拍卖仍能高效？传统理论认为一价拍卖因投标者压低报价会导致高达37%的社会福利损失（价格无效率性），但在代理市场中，模型能力相近或任务难度可预测可能缓解此问题。本文质疑悲观下界是否适用于此类新兴市场结构。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 模型考虑多个AI代理对用户提示（prompt）进行密封投标，最高出价者赢得服务权并支付其报价。每个代理知道自身响应质量期望与推理成本，其真实价值为收益减成本。投标策略构成贝叶斯纳什均衡，社会福利由获胜者的实际价值决定，目标是分析均衡下总福利相对于最优分配的比例。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文证明，在两类自然条件下，一价拍卖的价格无效率性显著低于经典1-1/e≈63%下界：一是存在‘竞争底价’，即多个代理对多数查询估值接近最优；二是代理价值在给定提示后近似独立。前者使福利下界随竞争强度提升至接近100%，后者恢复1-1/e²≈86.5%的紧界，均远优于一般情况。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 作者通过改进平滑论证（smoothness argument）来建立新下界：利用竞争底价约束最低可能成交价，并结合剩余价值上的标准分析；对于近似独立性，则量化总变差距离对独立情形下界的扰动影响。技术核心在于将结构假设转化为对均衡投标行为的约束，从而收紧福利损失估计。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 局限在于结果依赖于特定竞争结构与条件独立性假设，且仅分析均衡表现，未涵盖学习动态。然而，论文价值在于连接了机制设计理论与LLM部署实践，提供了评估去中心化代理市场的理论工具。最值得读的是其对现实市场特征如何改善理论下界的洞察及其仿真验证方法。

papers.title: PPAD-Completeness of Contiguous Envy-Free Cake Cutting with Additive Valuations
papers.titleZh: PPAD-Completeness of Contiguous Envy-Free Cake Cutting with Additive Valuations
papers.abstract: We prove that computing a complete contiguous $\varepsilon$-envy-free cake allocation is PPAD-complete for normalized rational piecewise-constant additive valuations. The hardness holds even when $\varepsilon$ is given in unary, and even when every density takes only two values, which are the same for all agents, and is piecewise constant with at most six breakpoints. As a consequence, computing an exact contiguous envy-free allocation is also PPAD-complete, and the hardness holds under the same restrictions on the densities. Our key ingredient is to assign prices to the pieces so that, in every approximately envy-free allocation, all prices are nearly equal, regardless of how the pieces are assigned to the agents. We further show that, for every fixed integer $c\ge1$, computing a contiguous EF$c$ allocation of indivisible goods on a path is PPAD-complete for additive valuations, and the hardness holds even for binary valuations in which each good is valued by exactly one agent and all agents value the same number of goods.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 为什么计算连通的无妒忌蛋糕分割如此困难？尽管已知这类分配总是存在，但在三人及以上时，没有任何有限协议能在标准查询模型中找到解。对于显式给出的加性估值，近似解的计算复杂性长期悬而未决，尤其是PPAD-完全性是否成立尚不清楚。本文正是针对这一理论缺口，探究在实际约束下该问题的固有计算难度。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 模型考虑一个区间[0,1]上的蛋糕，n个代理人各自拥有归一化的有理分段常数密度函数定义的加性估值。目标是将蛋糕划分为n个连续子区间并分配给代理人，使得每个代理人都不嫉妒他人。特别要求分配是完整的、连通的，并满足ε-无妒忌或精确无妒忌条件，同时允许估值密度仅取两个值且断点不超过六个。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文证明了计算连通的ε-无妒忌蛋糕分配是PPAD-完全的，即使ε以一进制编码、密度仅为两个相同值且至多六个断点也成立。由此推出精确无妒忌分配同样是PPAD-完全的。此外，对于路径上不可分物品的EFc分配，固定c≥1时也是PPAD-完全的，即使在二元估值下亦然，解决了此前关于EF1/EF2复杂性的开放问题。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 作者通过从阈值博弈的近似均衡进行搜索归约来证明硬度。核心技术是在蛋糕片段上隐式赋‘价格’，使得任何近似无妒忌分配中所有片段的价格几乎相等，无论分配顺序如何。结合循环序与奖金结构，利用拟线性效用下的偏好关系消去分配排列的影响，最终导出均衡条件。存在性部分则借助苏姆斯邦贡的构造性证明归入PPAD。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 虽然结果揭示了连通公平分配的计算本质难度，但归约构造较为复杂且实例中ε随n呈负四次方衰减，可能削弱对常数精度情形的适用性。不过，其技术路径新颖，特别是价格编码思想对其他公平划分问题有启发意义。最值得阅读的是核心归约构造、PPAD完备性论证及其对离散物品情形的拓展应用。

papers.title: No-Regret Learning in Stackelberg Security Games with an Unknown, Bounded Set of Attacker Types
papers.titleZh: 在未知且有界攻击者类型的斯塔克尔伯格安全博弈中的无悔学习
papers.abstract: In a repeated Stackelberg security game, a defender commits in every round to a randomized allocation of its resources, and an attacker, drawn from a set of types, best-responds. Existing no-regret guarantees assume that the defender knows this set of types in advance. We drop this assumption: the set of types is unknown, and its size is at most $K_{\max}$, an upper bound that the defender is not told. We show that what can be learned then depends on what the defender observes. If it observes the type of each attacker, an algorithm that adds types to its list as they appear achieves regret $\tilde O(nK_{\max}\sqrt{T})$ over $T$ rounds with $n$ targets, the same $\sqrt T$ rate as with known types, at an extra factor of only $\sqrt{K_{\max}}$ and without ever using $K_{\max}$. If it observes only the attacked target and types come from an infinite universe, no algorithm has sublinear regret: in a fixed three-target game every algorithm suffers regret at least $T-2$, even against a single attacker type, because it cannot tell which type it faces. If, in addition, it is told every $B$ rounds which types have appeared so far, sublinear regret returns, at $\tilde O(nK_{\max}^{4/3}T^{2/3}+K_{\max} B)$. The first term is the rate of the partial-information learner we use, and we show that the additive cost of the delay cannot be avoided.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 为什么在不知道攻击者类型集合的情况下仍可能实现无悔学习？现有研究通常假设防御者事先知道所有攻击者类型，但在现实中，新威胁不断出现且类型未知。本文探讨当攻击者类型集合未知但总数有界时，防御者能否通过不同反馈模式实现亚线性遗憾，并揭示学习成败的关键在于能否识别对手身份。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 模型设定为重复的斯塔克尔伯格安全博弈，防御者每轮承诺资源分配策略，攻击者观察后选择最优目标进行攻击。攻击者来自一个未知但规模至多为Kmax的类型集合，防御者的反馈分为三种情形：观测攻击者类型、仅观测被攻击目标、或每隔B轮获知此前出现过的类型列表。核心挑战是防御者需在信息受限下学习最优策略。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文发现反馈类型决定学习可能性：若能观测到每次攻击者的类型，则提出的GROW-CATALOG算法可达O(nKmax√T)遗憾，与已知类型情况仅差√Kmax因子；若只能观测被攻击目标且类型来自无限宇宙，则即使只有一个固定类型也无法实现亚线性遗憾；而若周期性获得类型列表，则可恢复亚线性遗憾，代价为O(KmaxB)的延迟项。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 作者采用分阶段重启的学习框架应对未知类型集合的增长。关键技术是结合专家算法与动态扩展的专家集，在类型更新时重启学习过程。对于延迟反馈情形，使用加倍技巧构造任意时间保证的局部学习器，并通过计数论证证明下界，揭示精确匹配搜索在高维类型空间中的根本困难。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 论文未解决√Kmax和Kmax^(1/3)因子是否必要，也未确认更优的√T学习器是否存在任意时间版本。尽管如此，其清晰划分了不同信息结构下的学习边界，揭示了‘识别对手’比‘类型数量有限’更重要的洞见，对安全博弈与在线学习的设计具有指导意义，值得细读其模型抽象与下界构造。

papers.title: What You Earn from What You Learn: Characterization and Complexity of the Value of Information
papers.titleZh: 从所学中获得什么：信息价值的刻画与复杂性
papers.abstract: We examine the value of information in extensive-form decision problems: the largest multiplicative gain that a decision maker can obtain from an information refinement, taken over all payoff environments. This measures the structural importance of information disentangled from any particular payoff specification, and generalizes the notion of value of recall recently introduced by Berker et al. (AAAI'25). We establish a unifying characterization of the value of information under any information refinement, uncovering an intriguing connection to the maximum fractional chromatic number over a certain family of conflict graphs. We then employ our characterization to elucidate the complexity of two central information refinements. First, for the value of perfect information in perfect-recall decision problems, we find that the relevant conflict graphs are cographs, so the fractional chromatic number collapses to the clique number. Even though the clique number is tractable for a given cograph, we show that the additional layer of optimization (over the family of graphs) makes computing the value of perfect information NP-complete. On the positive side, we prove fixed-parameter tractability in terms of the degree of imperfect information. Second, for the value of recall in imperfect-recall decision problems (with no absentmindedness), we first show that the value of recall can realize the fractional chromatic number of any graph. Interestingly, this implies that, unlike the value of perfect information, the value of recall can take fractional values. Building on this reduction, we then establish S2P-completeness. This addresses questions left open by Berker et al. (AAAI'25)---both on the characterization and the complexity of the value of recall---and shows that computing the value of recall is strictly harder than the value of perfect information.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 为什么信息的价值难以量化？传统方法依赖具体收益环境，无法分离信息结构本身的结构性影响。本文关注在序贯决策问题中，信息改进（如完美信息或完美记忆）所能带来的最大乘性增益，以此衡量信息的内在价值。这有助于理解隐私约束、记忆限制等场景下决策性能的根本瓶颈。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 模型基于扩展式决策问题，包含一个决策者、机会节点和信息集划分。决策者在信息集中无法区分节点，行动受限于当前信息。研究两种信息改进：一是完美信息（每个节点独立可观），二是完美回忆（恢复被遗忘的历史）。价值定义为所有非负收益环境下，改进前后最优期望收益的最大比值，从而剥离具体收益的影响。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文建立了统一刻画：信息价值等于一类冲突图上的最大分数染色数。由此发现，完美信息价值恒为整数且NP-完全，而回忆价值可为分数且更难——属于Σ₂^P-完全，严格高于前者。这揭示了不同类型信息改进在计算复杂性上的根本差异，解答了前人遗留的复杂性问题。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 核心方法是将策略执行路径间的冲突建模为图，并利用分数染色数刻画原问题策略对改进后策略的逼近能力。对于完美信息，冲突图为余图，分数染色退化为团数；而对于回忆价值，则通过归约嵌入任意图的分数染色问题，并结合可选边技巧提升至Σ₂^P-难度。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 模型假设无健忘症，限制了对循环路径的处理。结果高度理论化，机制不易直接应用。但其将信息价值转化为图论问题的视角极具启发性，证明技术层层递进，尤其适合希望深入理解信息、记忆与计算边界关系的研究者阅读，开放问题也指明了未来方向。

papers.title: Exact Cut Complexity of Equal-Length Proportional Cake Cutting
papers.titleZh: 等长比例蛋糕切割的精确切分复杂度
papers.abstract: We study proportional cake cutting under an equal-length constraint, where each of $n$ agents must receive a bundle of length exactly $1/n$ that is worth at least $1/n$ to that agent. Our main result determines the exact worst-case number of cuts needed to guarantee such an allocation, namely $2n-2$ for every $n$. This improves on the previously known quadratic upper bound. The proof combines the constrained necklace-splitting theorem with a recursive assignment argument based on Hall's theorem. The same bound extends to the stronger requirement of envy-freeness when $n$ is a prime power, and an $O(n^{1.525})$ upper bound holds for arbitrary $n$. We then ask whether such allocations can be computed. We first show that no deterministic protocol in the Robertson--Webb model terminates after finitely many queries on every instance and always returns an exact equal-length proportional allocation, even for two agents with identical valuations. For every $\varepsilon>0$, however, $O(n^2/\varepsilon)$ queries suffice to produce an allocation in which every agent receives a bundle of length exactly $1/n$ and value at least $1/n-\varepsilon$, again using at most $2n-2$ cuts. Finally, we augment the Robertson--Webb model with two-knife queries. We show that recursive balanced halving attains the optimal bound of $2n-2$ cuts when $n$ is a power of two. For arbitrary $n$, we give a procedure using $O(n\log n)$ cuts.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 为什么在蛋糕切割中强制每个代理获得恰好等长份额会显著增加切分代价？传统比例分配可用n-1刀完成，但加入等长约束后碎片化加剧。本文探究该约束下的最小切数，填补了公平分配中关于公共客观尺度（如时间、面积）与私有估值并存时的理论空白，揭示了结构约束如何改变问题本质。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 模型设定n个代理共享区间[0,1]，每人必须分得长度恰好1/n的子区间，且自评价值不低于1/n。代理拥有非原子私有估值，长度为公共已知量。目标是构造一个分配方案，在满足等长与比例性的前提下最小化使用的切点数。问题关注最坏情况下的精确切分复杂度，而非近似或期望性能。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文证明等长比例分配的精确最坏情况切数恰为2n-2，紧致上下界。此前仅知二次上界，此结果首次达成线性精确值。进一步表明当n为素幂时，等长无妒忌分配也只需2n-2刀；一般n下给出O(n^1.525)上界。同时证明在标准查询模型中无法有限步精确求解，但可高效逼近。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 核心方法结合约束项链分割定理与基于Hall定理的递归分配。利用素幂数情形下的拓扑存在性引理平衡初始分组，再递归求解子问题。对于查询复杂度，采用对抗论证证明不可能性，并通过网格离散化构造近似协议。两刀具查询的引入则使精确解可在增强模型中实现。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 主要局限在于精确解在标准模型中不可计算，且最优切数机制仅对特定n完全解决。结果依赖强结构性工具如拓扑组合，可能难以推广至更弱假设。最值得阅读的是其紧致复杂度分析、对约束公平性的深刻洞察，以及将经典定理创新组合的技术路径，开放问题亦具挑战性。

papers.title: Generative Representation Learning for Scalable Latent Tokenization
papers.titleZh: 用于可扩展潜在标记化的生成式表示学习
papers.abstract: We introduce an approach for self-supervised representation learning designed to be used as a tokenizer for generative modeling. Our objective supervises a representation loss by factorizing the pointwise mutual information of the data, which we estimate by taking information differences between conditional predictions from a learned generative model. We justify our algorithm theoretically and empirically, demonstrating that our generative approach to representation learning avoids dimensional collapse and feature suppression in cases where commonly used methods like DINO and LeJEPA fail. Moreover, we show our representation learning technique is scalable; expending more compute leads to predictably better latent tokenization. For the first time, we perform a careful analysis of the combined flop efficiency of tokenizer and generative model and demonstrate that our approach is a compute-optimal improvement over direct diffusion for pixel-space generation, obtaining an FID-50K of 2.18 with JiT-L. Applied to ImageNet and the text-to-image dataset GPIC, we show tokenizer encoder scaling laws for diffusability, where extrapolating our approach achieves representations in 7x fewer FLOPs than DINOv2 on ImageNet and 8x fewer FLOPs than WebSSL on GPIC.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 当前用于生成模型的表示学习方法（如DINO）并非为生成任务设计，常导致特征抑制和维度崩溃，且训练成本高昂。本文关注一个核心问题：是否存在一种表示学习算法，能随计算量增加持续提升生成性能，并在总计算效率上优于直接像素生成？这触及生成式AI中表示学习与生成建模的协同优化瓶颈。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 论文研究图像生成任务，输入为原始图像块，输出为高保真图像。模型通过Latent Forcing在潜空间去噪后生成像素，评估基于FID等指标。关键设定是隔离编码器质量影响，不使用解码器或感知损失。实验在ImageNet和GPIC上进行，重点测量编码器训练FLOPs与生成性能的关系，以验证可扩展性。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文提出RePR，首次证明表示学习可成为计算最优的生成路径。其核心贡献是发现编码器存在可预测的扩展规律：更多计算带来更优潜变量，使生成模型收敛更快。在同等FLOPs下，RePR+JiT的FID-50K达2.18，优于纯像素扩散，且达到相同质量所需FLOPs仅为DINOv2的1/7，验证了表示学习作为独立扩展轴的价值。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: RePR通过生成模型估计条件互信息来监督表示学习，避免对比学习中的负样本依赖和特征抑制。它利用扩散模型的ELBO估计点态互信息（PMI），并通过对patch级预测的增量PMI进行加权和引导表示因子分解。该方法无需负样本，天然抗特征饱和，并通过时间步加权聚焦语义相关信号，使表示学习可随生成模型同步扩展。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 论文未比较复杂解码器（如RAE）下的表现，且依赖Latent Forcing简化评估，实际部署需额外验证。其结论在无损生成路径中可信，但对压缩型潜空间的普适性待检验。最值得读的是其方法论设计——如何将生成目标反向注入表示学习，以及关于‘表示扩展律’的经验发现，这对构建下一代高效生成系统具有指导意义。

papers.title: Beyond Static Cues: Unified Dynamic Detection of MLLM Backdoors via Dual-Flow Trajectory Analysis
papers.titleZh: 超越静态线索：通过双流轨迹分析统一检测多模态大语言模型后门
papers.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are increasingly deployed in safety-critical domains, yet their susceptibility to backdoor attacks remains a formidable challenge. While existing defenses have evolved from visual-centric patch cues to unsupervised internal attention statistics, they are fundamentally constrained by a reliance on static snapshots and attack-specific heuristics. Given the intricate interplay between dual modalities, the vast design space for multimodal triggers allows diverse threats, such as textual injections, sub-perceptual noises, and coordinated cross-modal triggers, to easily circumvent such rigid priors, particularly when attack types are unknown in real-world applications. In this paper, we rethink backdoor detection by shifting the diagnostic paradigm from static observations to dynamic output evolution. We observe that a successful attack inevitably hijacks the model's decoding trajectory, skewing internal modal contributions during generation while maintaining an abnormal output invariance despite input perturbations. To capture this behavior, we propose EVO-Detect, a unified detection framework that monitors the dynamic evolution of internal signals during early decoding steps through two complementary channels: Attention Flow and Logits Flow. The attention branch measures how image-text attention allocation evolves during early generation, whereas the logits branch quantifies the sensitivity of the output distribution to modal perturbations through interventional ablations. We then convert these trajectories into compact sample-level metrics and normalize them against negative-control signatures so that natural perturbations are less likely to be mistaken for backdoor evidence. Extensive evaluations show that our approach substantially outperforms state-of-the-art baselines such as BYE and TCAP across diverse attack families.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 随着多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在关键场景中广泛应用，其在微调阶段遭受后门攻击的风险日益突出。现有防御方法依赖静态特征或特定模态线索，难以应对文本注入、视觉噪声或跨模态协同触发等多样化攻击，尤其在未知攻击形式的实际部署中表现脆弱。本文旨在建立一种不依赖先验知识、能统一识别各类后门的通用检测机制。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 研究聚焦于下游微调数据中的中毒样本过滤任务，输入为图像-文本对及对应模型，输出为可疑性评分以决定是否保留样本。方法无需访问干净锚点或修改模型参数，仅通过分析早期解码过程中注意力与输出分布的动态演化进行判断。评估涵盖多种攻击类型，在多个主流MLLM和数据集上测试净化后的攻击成功率与性能保持能力。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文提出了EVO-Detect框架，首次将后门检测从静态快照转向动态轨迹分析，实现了对视觉、文本及双模态攻击的统一高效拦截。实验显示其在最具挑战性的双触发攻击下平均攻击成功率降至5.2%，显著优于现有方法。结果表明，动态行为分析比静态内部信号更能揭示隐藏的劫持机制，为MLLM安全提供了更可靠的无监督检测路径。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 方法核心是双流轨迹分析：Attention Flow追踪图像-文本注意力分配在生成初期的持续偏移，Logits Flow通过干预消融测量模态间贡献不平衡的敏感性。结合控制感知的参考归一化机制，利用良性样本作为基线，并用负控样例抑制自然扰动导致的误报。该设计使检测基于劫持行为的本质动态，而非特定攻击表征，从而具备强泛化性。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 尽管性能优越，但该方法需额外计算开销（约2倍延迟），且依赖小规模良性参考池，在极端污染或长延迟攻击下可能退化。其核心价值在于提出了一种新的诊断范式——将检测锚定在解码动态而非静态特征。最值得细读的是问题分析、双流设计逻辑与归一化机制，这对理解未来MLLM安全机制具有启发意义。

papers.title: ActiveEvidence: Decision-Focused Evidence Graphs with Verifiable Acquisition Gaps
papers.titleZh: ActiveEvidence: 面向决策的可验证证据图与证据获取间隙
papers.abstract: A multimodal agent must decide whether visual evidence is worth acquiring, which candidate or resolution to query, and when further interaction can no longer change its decision. We study this problem under a strict free-metadata/paid-observation boundary, stochastic vector costs, and a frozen execution trace, and treat it as decision-certifiable active evidence acquisition. A Counterfactual Evidence Interaction Graph (CEIG) represents unary evidence value, signed second-order interaction, and directed conditional harm while maintaining explicit score enclosures for unresolved interactions; a decision-weighted enclosure objective tightens the bounds that can change action identity. Gap-directed refinement evaluates only interactions that can displace the incumbent acquisition and stops once an $ε$-decision certificate shows that unresolved terms cannot change the selected action beyond a declared tolerance. The certificate is model-relative: it verifies policy-consistent optimality under the pinned learned score, and semantic quality is measured separately through post-freeze labels. Paired continuation rollouts learn the downstream value of paid previews, an online operational cost filter is separated from independent finite-policy-family trajectory certification, and an acquisition monitor with an independently implemented verifier binds every certificate to the frozen trace. On 640 cases split into 384/128/128 training, validation, and test cases, the controller reaches task score 0.842, grounding F1 0.816, evidence recall 0.873, 1.74 accepted calls, 286.5K visual tokens, and 742ms p95 latency. Dense replay of issued certificates shows 0.992 action agreement and a 0.988 certificate rate while evaluating 19.6 instead of 191.4 expensive interaction terms per decision.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 多模态智能体在面临大量视觉候选证据时，需决定是否获取、获取哪个以及何时停止，但盲目获取代价高昂，而固定策略又可能遗漏关键信息。现有方法缺乏对‘当前决策是否已充分’的可验证判断，导致无法在资源消耗与决策质量之间取得可信平衡。本文聚焦于如何让智能体在动态证据获取过程中，提供可回溯、可验证的决策依据。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 智能体接收用户请求和带元数据的候选证据池，在每次交互中选择获取图像、预览、停止或放弃。输入包括请求、免费元数据、已获取内容及剩余预算，输出为动作决策。评估基于冻结执行轨迹后的语义正确性与资源消耗，核心指标包括任务得分、证据召回率、视觉标记量和延迟，并通过独立验证器重放轨迹以检验决策一致性。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文提出决策可认证的主动证据获取框架，其核心是带有显式分数边界的反事实证据交互图（CEIG），并引入基于间隙的精细化机制，在仅评估可能改变决策的关键交互后即可生成ε-决策证书。实验显示该方法在保持高任务得分0.842和证据召回率0.873的同时，显著降低计算开销，每步仅评估19.6个昂贵交互而非191.4个，且证书重放一致性达0.992。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: CEIG建模证据的一元价值、二阶交互与条件损害，训练时采用决策加权的边界损失，使不确定性边界在影响决策的关键边上更紧致。推理时采用间隙导向的精细化策略，仅解析可能缩小领先动作与挑战者差距的交互，一旦剩余不确定性不足以改变决策即终止。证书绑定至冻结轨迹，由独立实现的验证器检查决策一致性与完整性。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 方法依赖离线生成的反事实监督信号，前期计算成本高，需约1290次查询才能回本，限制了低频场景的应用。语义质量依赖事后标注，证书本身仅保证模型相对最优。最值得阅读的是其将决策终止转化为可验证计算的思想、间隙导向精细化机制的设计，以及跨实现重放验证的严谨评测体系。

papers.title: Cortex: Consolidating Context into Parametric Memory
papers.titleZh: Cortex: 将上下文整合到参数化记忆中
papers.abstract: Context can improve large language model performance, but these gains may be lost after context removal. Inspired by biological systems consolidation, we formulate Memory Consolidation (MC) as internalizing these gains while preserving non-target capabilities, connecting context-specified editing, skill learning, and behavioral steering under a common objective. We introduce a five-task-family testbed measuring consolidation and retention under single, batch, and sequential updates. We propose Cortex, which generates prospective queries to anticipate uses of context and distills context-conditioned outputs into mergeable low-rank or structural feed-forward network updates. Across 4B--120B dense and mixture-of-experts backbones, including both text-only and multimodal models, Cortex lies on the empirical consolidation--retention Pareto frontier in most evaluated settings. After 50 sequential factual edits on a 14B model, Cortex-Structural recovers 88.9% of the context-induced gain while retaining 99.8% of original non-target performance.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 大型语言模型虽能通过上下文临时提升性能，但一旦移除上下文，增益往往消失，这反映了‘记忆失效’问题。现有方法如上下文蒸馏依赖外部数据分布或无法兼顾能力保持，难以实现长期知识内化。本文由此提出‘记忆巩固’问题，旨在将上下文带来的收益转化为持久的参数化记忆，同时不损害原有能力。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 论文定义了记忆巩固任务：在无访问原始上下文的情况下，使模型恢复其带来的性能增益，并保留非目标能力。为此构建了一个涵盖五类任务（如事实编辑、技能学习）的测试平台，评估单次、批量和连续更新下的巩固率（CR）与保留率（RR）。实验覆盖4B至120B规模的多种模型结构，输入均为文本，评价基于人工构建的上下文与查询对。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文提出了CoRTEX框架，在多数设置下达到巩固与保留的帕累托前沿。其关键贡献在于统一处理知识编辑、行为引导等任务的记忆内化问题。实验证明，经过50次连续编辑后，CoRTEX-Structural恢复了88.9%的增益并保留99.8%原有性能，显著优于基线，验证了小规模增量更新积累有效记忆的可行性。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: CoRTEX通过生成前瞻性查询来预判上下文的未来用途，并利用上下文条件下的输出作为监督目标，将其蒸馏为低秩或结构性前馈网络（FFN）更新。更新仅限于FFN层，采用冻结主干、训练新增参数的方式减少干扰。通过输出分布对齐与隐藏状态匹配联合优化，确保行为复制与中间表示一致性。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 方法依赖模型自身生成训练数据，可能存在偏差；共享MoE扩展的有效性在更广场景中需进一步验证。尽管如此，其对记忆巩固的建模、前瞻性排练机制及轻量更新设计极具启发性。最值得阅读的是其问题形式化、测试平台设计与消融分析，为持续学习与参数化记忆提供了可靠实验基础。

papers.title: Look Before You Restore: Learning to Predict Before Acting for Agentic Image Restoration
papers.titleZh: Look Before You Restore: Learning to Predict Before Acting for Agentic Image Restoration
papers.abstract: Agents for mixed-degradation image restoration typically learn what a tool does to an image only after running it: failed calls waste computation and harmful outputs go unnoticed until too late. We propose PreActIR, an agentic restoration framework that predicts tool consequences before execution. For each candidate tool, a tool-conditioned world model forecasts changes in residual degradation, image quality, and fidelity, together with the risk of harm and the uncertainty of the prediction. The agent executes the top-ranked candidate, and an independent verifier commits or rolls back its output before the agent replans from the observed state. PreActIR also audits whether performance is limited by the selector or by the candidate space, and studies targeted tool adaptation as a controlled way to expand that space. In a controlled evaluation that fixes the candidate pool, verifier, and budget and employs reference-annotated degradation states, PreActIR uses 42.5% fewer real tool calls and 63.4% fewer rejected calls than reactive, execute-then-evaluate trial and error, while improving Y-PSNR by 0.92 dB.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 现有基于智能体的图像恢复方法通常采用试错机制，在调用修复工具后才能观察其效果，导致无效操作浪费计算资源并可能引入不可逆损伤。这类方法缺乏对动作后果的预判能力，难以在复杂退化场景下高效决策。本文指出核心瓶颈在于反应式执行模式与工具空间限制之间的模糊权衡，无法区分性能瓶颈源于选择策略不佳还是可用工具不足。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 论文在混合退化图像恢复任务上构建了一个可预测动作后果的智能体系统，输入为退化图像与候选工具集，输出为经验证的修复结果。系统通过离线训练的世界模型预测每个工具对残余退化、质量与保真度的影响，并在推理时结合独立验证器进行回滚控制。实验基于MiO100数据集与AgenticIR协议，使用Y-PSNR、SSIM等指标评估，在固定预算下比较真实调用次数与拒绝率。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文提出PreActIR框架，首次实现对图像修复工具效果的部署时预测，显著减少无效调用。在控制变量的回放实验中，相比反应式试错，其真实工具调用减少42.5%，被拒调用减少63.4%，同时Y-PSNR提升0.92dB。此外，通过候选前沿审计可量化选择器与工具集的相对瓶颈，为系统改进提供诊断依据。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: PreActIR采用‘预测-行动-验证’循环：工具条件化世界模型预测各候选动作的退化变化、质量增益、内容损伤及不确定性；智能体据此排序并执行最优候选；独立验证器决定提交或回滚。世界模型在真实转换数据上监督训练，预测多维后果而非单一分数。离线审计通过求解最大保真度组合来刻画工具集上限，指导有针对性的工具适配。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 方法依赖标注退化状态进行训练与评估，实际部署时估计误差可能影响预测可靠性；验证器与世界模型存在相关误差，未完全解耦风险。结果在受控回放中验证，未测试于动态估计状态下的长期规划收益。最值得阅读的是其系统级设计思想——预测前置、验证后置与能力审计的三重机制，为可靠视觉智能体提供了可扩展范式。
